title: Microsoft stops on Friday the 13th – level 1
paragraphs: A big computer problem at Microsoft stops many services around the world on Friday. People cannot use Outlook email, Teams, or other work apps for hours.
Microsoft says that its main computers have too much work. They stop working. But it is not an attack by hackers. The company starts slowly fixing the problem.

Technology experts say that companies should not use only one big tech company for everything. If one system breaks, people cannot do their jobs. Businesses need good backup plans so they can keep working when a problem comes.

words.d: the biggest or most important thing
an extra copy of data or a plan for a situation when something stops working
